fieldData.description: On Saturday the 2nd July, we will have the first Atomic Series of Radix meetups where we blend tech, community and fun into one jam packed event. The afternoon session will see talks from two of the Radix team members with all the latest news and updates from RDX Works HQ. We will also have a keynote speaker from a member of the Outlier Ventures team, one of the leading Web3 startup accelerators. For our developers, we will have a dev showcase with some of the Radix community projects showcasing their own projects as we head towards Babylon. The session will round off with a panel discussing what the future of Web3 on Radix may look like. Then in the evening, we will be heading next door to a social darts venue where you can try your hand at winning one of the many NFT and XRD prizes in the darts competitions. Places are limited! You will need to reseve a place at both day event and after party should you wish to attend both. **Please do not reserve a ticket if you're not 100% sure you will be able to attend**
